profile.headline: Front-End & Full-Stack Web Developer | 12+ Years in Web Development
profile.jobTitle: Web Developer | Website Services Consultant | Graphic Designer
profile.summary:
I'm a Front-End and Full-Stack Web Developer with 12 years of professional experience, combining a foundation in graphic design with modern web technologies to create engaging, reliable, and user-friendly digital experiences.

My background spans front-end development, WordPress, WooCommerce, SuiteCommerce, BigCommerce, API integrations, and technical project coordination. Career highlights include helping deliver a 1,000+ page WordPress website in six weeks and developing a website that reached approximately 60,000 monthly organic visitors. More recently, I've expanded into full-stack engineering, building and deploying applications with React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Docker, and Azure.

I'm energetic, creative, easygoing, and passionate about web development. A good listener and collaborative teammate, I approach technical challenges with a positive "we can figure this out" attitude. I enjoy sharing ideas, learning new technologies, and finding practical solutions that help teams and clients succeed. I'm excited to bring my experience, creativity, and growing full-stack expertise to a collaborative team, building meaningful web applications and digital solutions.

positions.title: Web Developer | Website Services Consultant | Graphic Designer
positions.description:
Run a web development, hosting, and graphic design business serving nonprofits, law firms, child care centers, and small businesses. Manage client websites, hosting, performance, security, and technical support in English and Spanish.

• Manage a portfolio of WordPress websites through SiteGround and WP Umbrella, configuring automated updates, safe update procedures, and ongoing maintenance.

• Optimize website performance and security through Cloudflare, SiteGround caching, WordPress troubleshooting, DNS configuration, and bot protection.

• Develop and customize WordPress websites using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and plugins, including WooCommerce and GiveWP integrations.

• Provide technical consulting, SEO improvements, hosting solutions, and graphic design services, including logos and marketing materials.
positions.insights: Skills: Wordpress Development · Communication · CSS Grid Layout · Usability · Web Design · PHP · Bootstrap (Framework) · CSS3 · Organization Skills · CSS Flexbox · WordPress · Responsive Web Design · Web Development · FTP · GitHub · SASS · Adobe XD · Elementor · Content Management Systems (CMS) · Front-end · WooCommerce

positions.title: Web Developer Ticket Manager
positions.description:
Managed web development requests while contributing hands-on development, technical troubleshooting, website integrations, and WordPress maintenance.

• Helped deliver a 1,000+ page WordPress website in approximately six weeks, coordinating a four-developer team and building PHP/SQL solutions for content extraction, migration, and automated page generation.

• Managed the development ticket lifecycle, including prioritization, task assignments, troubleshooting, quality assurance, and resolution of technical issues.

• Developed and customized WordPress websites using PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS/SCSS, Elementor Pro, ACF, Gravity Forms, and WooCommerce.

• Implemented API and workflow integrations connecting WordPress forms and website functionality with external business systems.

• Maintained and optimized client websites, addressing performance, caching, spam protection, Cloudflare configuration, and website migrations.
positions.insights: Skills: Elementor · monday.com · Troubleshooting · Project Management · WP Engine · Flywheel · Wordpress Development · WordPress · PHP

positions.title: SuiteCommerce Theme Developer
positions.description:
Developed and customized NetSuite SuiteCommerce storefronts, focusing on responsive design, theme functionality, and e-commerce user experience.

• Customized SuiteCommerce Base Themes using HTML, Handlebars, Sass/SCSS, CSS, and JavaScript to implement client-specific designs and storefront functionality.

• Configured theme settings and customization options within NetSuite to support client branding, layouts, and storefront requirements.

• Troubleshot and resolved styling, layout, and front-end functionality issues across SuiteCommerce websites.

• Collaborated with developers and project teams using Git and Azure DevOps for version control, code reviews, and deployment workflows.
positions.insights: Skills: NetSuite · SuiteCommerce · Handlebars.js · JavaScript · npm · Node.js · GitHub · Azure DevOps · HTML · CSS3 · Bootstrap (Framework) · Responsive Web Design · monday.com · Git · Microsoft Visual Studio Code · Gulp.js

positions.title: Frontend WordPress Developer
positions.description:
Served as the primary web developer and designer for client websites, managing development, customization, troubleshooting, and deployment across multiple projects.

• Developed and maintained responsive WordPress websites using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Divi, WPBakery, and Elementor, translating provided designs and customized templates into functional websites.

• Managed website projects independently, working directly with clients and project managers to gather requirements, implement changes, and deliver completed websites.

• Implemented e-commerce functionality, on-page SEO improvements, and website updates to support client business needs.

• Managed hosting configurations, domain settings, FTP deployments, and production launches, troubleshooting technical issues throughout the development process.

positions.title: Web Designer | Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained websites for a variety of clients, primarily translating provided designs into responsive, functional websites while also contributing original designs when needed.

• Built and customized websites using WordPress, Joomla, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP, adapting layouts and functionality to client requirements.

• Managed website development tasks independently, from implementation and troubleshooting through testing and production launch.

• Implemented e-commerce functionality, on-page SEO improvements, and responsive layouts to support client business needs.

• Handled website hosting, domain configuration, content updates, and migrations, resolving technical issues to keep client websites operational.

positions.title: Software and Hardware Support Technician
positions.description:
Provided technical support for automotive paint and shop management systems, troubleshooting software, hardware, and network issues for business customers.

• Supported Axalta ColorNet and ProfitNet applications, diagnosing software issues and maintaining Windows workstations, servers, and connected equipment.

• Installed, configured, and troubleshot LAN/TCP/IP networks, paint mixing equipment, electronic scales, scanners, printers, and touchscreen systems.

• Developed an internal technical support website using WordPress, HTML, CSS, and Windows Server/IIS, incorporating Microsoft SQL Server to store and retrieve support information.

• Provided on-site technical assistance and training, helping customers resolve issues and operate their systems effectively.
positions.insights: Skills: Windows Server · Communication · Problem Solving · Troubleshooting · Teamwork · Organization Skills · FTP · Computer Hardware · Help Desk Support · Software Installation

projects.title: CT Ticket System (Client Tracking Ticket System) — Full-Stack Web Application
projects.description:
Designed, built, and deployed a full-stack ticket management application using React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL.

• Developed a responsive React interface connected to a REST API with persistent database storage.

• Implemented authentication and role-based access control for secure ticket management.

• Containerized the backend with Docker and deployed the application to Microsoft Azure.

• Built a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline for automated testing, container builds, and deployment.

Ongoing development includes refining functionality, improving performance, and expanding features.

projects.title: Carlogia — Portfolio Redesign & Deployment
projects.description:
Designed, customized, and launched my personal developer portfolio in less than one week using Figma Make and AI-assisted React development.

• Directed the visual design, customized responsive layouts, content, and interactive elements.

• Configured GitHub Actions to automate deployment to SiteGround via SSH.

• Delivered a production-ready portfolio showcasing professional projects, technical skills, and full-stack development experience.

Project URL: https://carlogia.com/
